summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on July 23, 2026, for a proposed common share offering under an existing shelf registration. The filing discloses a multi-class capital structure with Common Shares, Series A Preferred (convertible from April 2027, $25 stated value), and Series B Preferred (100,000 votes per share). The offering price and number of shares are left blank as preliminary. Underwriting fees are 7% of gross proceeds. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine equity capital raise. Risk-arb: not applicable.
